mapper.update: UPDATE T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO t1 JOIN ( SELECT t.FACTORY_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, MAX(t.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC) AS MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC FROM T_MDM_SKU_CONSTRUCTION_REF t WHERE t.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY t.FACTORY_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE ) t2 ON t1.FACTORY_CODE = t2.FACTORY_CODE AND t1.MATERIAL_CODE = t2.MATERIAL_CODE SET t1.EMBRYO_DESC = t2.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC t1.EMBRYO_CODE = t2.EMBRYO_CODE, t1.UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, t1.UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime} WHERE t1.IS_DELETE = 0
